segments.name: Global Pet Care
segments.description: Sells companion animal chews, treats and care products, dog and cat food, and aquatics products to pet retailers and consumers.
segments.evidence: GPC sells products within the companion animal, dog and cat food and aquatics product categories.

segments.name: Home and Garden
segments.description: Sells household and outdoor pest controls, weed control, insect repellents and household cleaning products to retailers and distributors.
segments.evidence: H&G sells products in the household and outdoor controls, repellents, and cleaning product categories.

segments.name: Home and Personal Care
segments.description: Sells small home appliances and personal care appliances to large retailers, e-commerce, wholesalers and specialty outlets.
segments.evidence: HPC sells products in the small home appliances and personal care appliance product categories.

revenueModel.text: The company is paid by retailers, wholesalers, distributors and e-commerce customers, with sales made through a direct sales force and network of brokers and distributors.
revenueModel.evidence: Product sales are generally through our direct sales force and network of brokers and distributors primarily with large retailers, pet superstores, e-commerce, food and drug retailers, warehouse clubs and other pet specialty retail
